title: Maximum Good People Based on Statements
goal: Find the largest group that can consistently be considered good.
strategy: Enumerate who is good. Only statements made by assumed-good people constrain the assignment; each known statement must agree with the target person status.

phasePurposes.start: Find the largest group that can consistently be considered good.
phasePurposes.inspect: Enumerate who is good. Only statements made by assumed-good people constrain the assignment; each known statement must agree with the target person status.
phasePurposes.update: Enumerate who is good. Only statements made by assumed-good people constrain the assignment; each known statement must agree with the target person status.
phasePurposes.done: Find the largest group that can consistently be considered good.

edgeCases: Unknown statements allow everyone to be good
Two people accusing each other allow at most one good person
One person with no statement can be good
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
